biotools.summary: IPAseek is a dynamic programming framework that identifies intronic polyadenylation (IPA) events in bulk RNA-seq data. It is designed to robustly detect complex IPA isoforms in various hematopoietic cell types, providing insights into transcriptome diversity and epigenetic regulation.
